# A knight (generated by make_env.py): 0.85 m tall, origin at the feet, facing -Y.
new
material new Steel --base-color 0.455 0.337 0.608 --no-slot
material new Tunic --base-color 0.588 0.984 0.780 --no-slot
material new Shield --base-color 1.0 0.702 0.796 --no-slot
material new Boss --base-color 0.969 1.0 0.682 --no-slot
material new Plume --base-color 1.0 0.702 0.796 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name LegL --size 1 --location -0.090 0.000 0.140
scale 0.120 0.140 0.280
apply --scale
material assign Steel
add mesh cube --name LegR --size 1 --location 0.090 0.000 0.140
scale 0.120 0.140 0.280
apply --scale
material assign Steel
add mesh cube --name Body --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.420
scale 0.360 0.260 0.340
apply --scale
material assign Tunic
add mesh cube --name ArmL --size 1 --location -0.230 -0.020 0.440
scale 0.100 0.120 0.280
apply --scale
material assign Steel
add mesh cube --name ArmR --size 1 --location 0.230 -0.020 0.440
scale 0.100 0.120 0.280
apply --scale
material assign Steel
add mesh cylinder --name Helm --vertices 6 --radius 0.15 --depth 0.24 --location 0 0 0.72
material assign Steel
add mesh cone --name Plume --vertices 4 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0.0 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0.05 0.94 --rotation -30 0 0
material assign Plume
add mesh cylinder --name Shield --vertices 8 --radius 0.21 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0.17 0.45 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Shield
add mesh cylinder --name BossK --vertices 4 --radius 0.07 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0.21 0.45 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Boss
select all
shade flat
export knight.glb
